release_notes: Fixed: Admin-panel updates now automatically recover from unfinished merges and the 'Pulling is not possible because you have unmerged files' state. A conflicting stash restore is cleaned up so later updates keep working, while the saved local changes remain in git stash. Important: an installation that is already stuck on 0.9.7.2 needs one SSH recovery before it can receive this fix: sudo -u www-data git -C /var/www/orbitra reset --hard HEAD && sudo -u www-data git -C /var/www/orbitra pull --ff-only origin main. Fixed: Cloaking no longer flags residential providers such as Comcast, CloudMTS and InterServer as hosting traffic. Added: Traffic Simulation now runs the real Cloak detector and shows ASN/ISP, passive detection reasons, JS execution and webdriver results.
